title: ready-06: widgets heca-pro needs — lines, tree layout, multi-line input, message list
summary: Four library widgets/capabilities missing for the agent diagram and chat.
description:
Found while designing heca-pro's components (`~/projects/heca-pro/docs/components.md`, "Widgets the library is missing"). They go into heca's widget library (`heca-grid-ui`) so plugins get them too.

## Current state
- `heca-grid-ui/src/scene.rs:304` — `DrawCommand` has Rect, Brackets, Text, Scanline, PushClip/PopClip, Host. No line or path.
- Catalog: `docs/widgets.md` — Flex, Grid, Card, Panel, Overlay, Input (single line), ScrollRegion, Toast, …

## Goal
1. **Lines and arrows** — a drawing command for lines (with arrow heads), painted by the renderer (`heca-renderer`), theme-driven width/colour.
2. **Tree layout** — a container that places a parent above its children and draws the connections, composed from Flex/Grid plus the line command; sizes as shares, never computed pixels.
3. **Multi-line text input** — grows with its content up to a limit, then scrolls; same keymap/intent model as Input.
4. **Message list** — wrapped text entries, grows as entries arrive, keeps the bottom in view while you are at the bottom (also helps F009/P055/T508, notification text cut short).
Each gets a showcase entry and a `docs/widgets.md` section.

## Preserve
- AGENTS.md § 0b (if it can be built in heca-grid-ui it belongs there), DOM-shaped events, a widget never hit-tests by hand; docs/layout.md for sizes.

## Done when
- Each widget is in the showcase, driven in the GPU app by Antonio, and documented.

tasks.description:
Execution task for P103. Read the phase description first. Run the pre-flight for each of the four types separately (AGENTS.md § 0): which existing widget, which task, or a proposal.

Current: `heca-grid-ui/src/scene.rs:304` `DrawCommand` has no line; the renderer is `heca-renderer`. Input is single-line (`heca-grid-ui/src/widgets/input.rs`). Edge cases: lines crossing clips; tree with one child / many children / nested; multi-line input with IME and selection; message list keeping the bottom in view only while the user is at the bottom.
